chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab narrated to us from Hammad b. Isa from al-Husayn b. al-Mukhtar from Abi Abdillah Ja'far b. Muhammad al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).
He said: Surely, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, hates the one who sells his merchandise by swearing false oaths.

key_terms.المنفق: the one who sells/markets his goods

ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about merchants who swear false oaths to sell their merchandise?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, the sixth Imam teaches that Allah detests merchants who promote their goods through false oaths. This addresses a common practice in marketplaces where sellers would swear by Allah to vouch for their merchandise, condemning the abuse of divine names for worldly profit.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from Hammad b. `Isa from al-Husayn b. al-Mukhtar from Abi `Abdillah Ja`far b. Muhammad al-Sadiq (as).
He said: Surely, Allah hates one who swears a false oath to overprice his merchandise.
